name: edge-access
description: Cloudflare edge-side passphrase access control for external review sites, including login, signed sessions, audit events, and authenticated origin forwarding.
cardTemplate: Summarise the edge-access domain: a fail-closed Cloudflare Worker gate using a shared passphrase, signed session cookies, privacy-minimized audit events, and authenticated origin forwarding.
rationale: The Worker runs outside the Excubitor process at a separate trust boundary and should not be classified as the backend HTTP API, frontend UI, or in-process logging pipeline.
